name: article-card-catalog
purpose: Select published articles by source, category and search; insert a native HTML card containing the cover, title and publication date.

endpoints.images: https://kolodahearthstone.com/; local attachment URLs remain owned by WordPress/S3
endpoints.reverse_provider: On Koloda the remote provider is https://hs-manacost.ru/wp-json/wp/v2/ with the same posts/categories/detail contract. Local provider resolves through WordPress queries.

authentication: Purpose-specific nonce and edit_post for the edited WordPress document. Provider GET requests have no credentials, forwarded cookies or user identifiers.

retry.backoff: Explicit user retry; 30-second provider-wide cooldown on error; honor numeric or HTTP-date Retry-After between 30 and 3600 seconds.

idempotency: Read-only GET and HTML generation. No provider writes; native editor insert is undoable and does not save the post automatically.
rate_limit: 10 posts per page, at most 100 decoded records, 512 KiB response cap, 5-minute query-specific cache, debounced search and cancellation of obsolete UI results.
degradation: Visible error with retry; preserve article editor text. Local catalog works during provider failure. Existing cards are stored native HTML and require no provider API request at render or save time. A missing cover leaves the title, date and link usable.
privacy: Only selected public filters leave the server; no article bodies are requested. External cover images are loaded by readers' browsers, revealing their normal network address to Koloda; editor previews use no-referrer. No new tracking scripts, cookies or personal-data storage. Search results expire after 5 minutes.
rollback: Revert the plugin release through the normal pipeline. Already inserted HTML remains readable and linked even without plugin CSS. No DB schema, media mutation or destructive uninstall.
